1. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method of providing a user with access to a resource of a contact center, comprising the steps of: (a) providing a search engine interface to a user's computer system for searching documents on one or more websites; (b) receiving a search query from the user's computer system via said interface; (c) sending a request based on said search query to a computerised system of a contact center __in response to a user action indicating an intent to contact the contact center__; (d) receiving, in response to said request, data enabling a contact center link to be provided to said user, wherein said contact center link, when activated, initiates an interactive communications session between the user and a resource of the contact center __selected based on the search query context and user profile information__; and (e) returning said contact center link to said user as part of a response to said search query __integrated with document search results in a manner that distinguishes the contact center link from standard web document links__.

2. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, further comprising the steps of conducting a search within said documents on one or more websites in response to said search query, and returning at least one document link to one of said documents as part of said response to said search query __wherein the document links are obtained from a web index maintained separately from contact center data__.

3. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 2, further comprising the step of formatting said response to said search query to display a first result set including said document link and a second result set including said contact center link __wherein the second result set is visually distinguished from the first result set through formatting, layout, or labeling__.

4. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said data received in step (d) enable a plurality of contact center links to be provided to said user __each corresponding to different contact center resources or departments selected based on the search query content__.

5. (Previously presented) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said data received in step (d) comprise said contact center link.

6. (Previously presented) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said data received in step (d) comprise an identifier of a link cached by the search engine.

7. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link is generated uniquely for said user __at the time of generating the search response__, whereby activation of the link initiates an interactive communications session recognisable by the contact center as relating to said request from said search engine __and traceable to the specific search query that prompted the contact center link generation__.

8. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said request sent to said contact center includes an identifier of said user __and metadata describing the search query context__, whereby a subsequent interactive communications session between the user and a resource of the contact center arising from initiation of said contact center link enables the contact center to associate said interactive communications session with said request from the search engine __and to provide contextually relevant assistance based on the search query__.

9. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 8, wherein said identifier of said user is a network address of said user __and said metadata includes the search query terms and timestamp of the search__.

10. (Previously presented) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link when activated, initiates an interactive communications session between the user and a predetermined agent of the contact center selected in response to said request.

11. (Previously presented) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link when activated, initiates an interactive communications session between the user and a predetermined queue of agents of the contact center selected in response to said request.

12. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said link is configured to initiate a communications session from a compatible communications application __pre-installed on said user's computer__, if such application is available on said user's computer.

13. (Previously presented) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 12, wherein said communications application is a voice or video telephony application.

14. (Previously presented) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 12, wherein said communications application is an instant messaging (IM) application.

15. (Previously presented) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 12, wherein said communications application is integrated with a browser employed by the user to access the search engine interface.

16. (New) [Claim 16 reserved]

17. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link contains parameters representing customer requirements __derived from analysis of the search query__ which are passed to said contact center within an interactive communications session initiated on activation of said contact center link.

18. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said parameters are indicative of one or more skillset parameters employed by a management system of said contact center __and are determined at the time of search response generation__, whereby said communications session may be directly assigned to a skillset based on the parameters.

19. (Cancelled)

20. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented search engine system providing a user with access to a resource of a contact center, comprising: (a) a server for providing a search engine interface to a user's computer system for searching documents on one or more websites and receiving a search query from the user's computer system via said interface; (b) an interface for providing communication with a computerised system of a contact center __configured to transmit requests only upon detection of user intent to contact the contact center__; (c) a request generator for formulating a request based on said search query for sending to said computerised system of a contact center __and including user profile and search context information__; (d) a results generator for providing to said user a contact center link based on data received in response to said request, said contact center link being configured such that, when activated, it enables an interactive communications session between the user and a resource of the contact center __and is visually and functionally distinguished from standard web search result links__.

21. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method of providing a user with access to a resource of a contact center, comprising the steps of: (a) receiving from a search engine a request based on a search query submitted to the search engine by a user's computer system __wherein the request includes an explicit indicator that the user seeks contact center assistance__; (b) determining, from said request, the identity of at least one selected resource of the contact center based on stored rules __that correlate search query characteristics with contact center resources__; (c) sending to the search engine, in response to said request, data enabling a contact center link to be provided to said user, whereby said contact center link, when activated, will initiate an interactive communications session between the user and said selected resource of the contact center __and will communicate the search query context to the selected resource__; (d) receiving, from said user, a communications session initiation from which said selected resource may be identified; and (e) directing said communications session to said selected resource.

22. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, wherein said data comprise an address of said selected resource __and routing information specific to that resource__, whereby activation of the link enables the user to initiate a communications session directly with said resource.

23. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, wherein said data comprises an identification, for inclusion in a contact center link to be returned to the user, of one or more skillset parameters employed by a management system of said contact center __that are matched to the search query content__, whereby said communications session may be directly assigned to a skillset based on the parameters.

24. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, wherein said data comprises a unique identifier, for inclusion in a contact center link to be returned to the user, said unique identifier being assigned to said request received from said search engine __and generated at the time of request receipt__, whereby a later communications session may be associated with said request based on said unique identifier being communicated within said communications session.

25. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, further comprising the step, carried out after having received a communications session initiation from the user, of amending the stored rules __to reflect the outcome of the communications session and the accuracy of the resource selection__.

26. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 25, wherein the amendment of the stored rules confirms an association between the request received from the search engine and the resource identified in a contact center link activated by the user __by updating correlation data used for future resource selection__.

27. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 25, wherein the amendment of the stored rules confirms an association between the request received from the search engine and a resource of the contact center which is different from that specified in a contact center link activated by the user but to which the user's communications session is ultimately directed __by recording instances where initial resource selection was overridden__.

28. (Cancelled)

29. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented contact center system for providing users with access to a resource of a contact center system, comprising (a) an interface for receiving from a search engine a request based on a search query submitted to the search engine by a user's computer system __wherein the request includes search context and user profile data__ and for returning data to the search engine in response to the request; (b) a storage area storing rules for determining, from the request, the identity of at least one selected resource of the contact center based on stored rules __that correlate search query characteristics with contact center resource capabilities and availability__; and (c) processing means programmed to determine the identity of at least one selected resource of the contact center based on the stored rules and to generate data enabling a contact center link to be provided to the user, whereby the contact center link, when activated, will initiate an interactive communications session between the user and the selected resource of the contact center __and will transmit the search query context to the selected resource__; wherein the processor is operably connected to the interface to receive the request therefrom and to provide the data thereto.
